snippet.title: Turok: Origins – Nintendo Direct: Partner Showcase 2.5.2026
snippet.description:
Turok: Origins is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in fall 2026.

The legend of Turok returns! Hunt down prehistoric beasts and fight an alien threat across the Lost Lands in Turok: Origins.

#TurokOrigins #NintendoSwitch2 #NintendoDirect
